models.name: OPTOMAX
models.firmware_note: the manual mentions an OPTOMAX-100 with a typical on-resistance of 1.8 mOhm; other ratings not stated
models.spec_source: Kontronik_Optomax.pdf p.2: names OPTOMAX-100 with 1.8 mOhm typical on-resistance only; no rating stated

automatable_note: A short-circuit bridge must be fitted on the two gold contacts before power-up; removing it before the storing signal turns undervoltage cutoff off. The bench cannot do this.

manual.action: Fit the short-circuit bridge on the two gold contacts.
manual.action_de: Kurzschlussbrücke auf die beiden Goldkontakte stecken.

manual.action: To switch the cutoff off, pull the bridge before the double signal.
manual.action_de: Zum Ausschalten der Abschaltung die Brücke vor dem Doppelsignal abziehen.

entry.confirm_signal: One signal after about 5 s recognises the brake or motor-off position.
steps: Receiver lead in the motor channel. Transmitter on, receiver battery connected. Throttle and trim to brake if a brake is wanted, else motor-off.
Operator: fit the short-circuit bridge on the two gold contacts.
Apply drive power. After about 5 s a signal confirms the brake / motor-off position.
Move the throttle to full and hold it until the signal, about 5 s after the last one.
No brake: leave the throttle at full. Brake: move the throttle to motor-off.
After about 5 s a signal confirms the brake activation.
Hard brake: move the throttle to full again. Soft brake: keep the throttle where it is.
After about 5 s a double signal stores all settings. Undervoltage cutoff stays on if the bridge is still fitted at this moment; remove it before the double signal to switch the cutoff off.
Disconnect drive power and remove the bridge.

announce.description: Single signals end intermediate steps; a double signal stores. Signal = LED flash plus beep when the motor and drive battery are connected.

select.description: Stick sequence sets the brake level.

scheme.confirm_signal: Double signal after about 5 s: settings stored.
scheme.exit: Disconnect power and remove the bridge.
scheme.description: Stick-position teach-in with three brake levels (none, soft, hard) and a cutoff on/off decision taken by the bridge state at the storing signal.

values.name: none: throttle stays at full after the full-throttle signal
soft: throttle at motor-off, kept there
hard: throttle at motor-off, then back to full
on: bridge still fitted at the double signal
off: bridge removed before the double signal

unknowns: Signal is an LED flash with a beep when the motor is connected; beep duration is not stated.
The ~5 s intervals are approximate; their tolerance is not stated.
A wrong programming attempt shows no double signal; the ESC then stores nothing.
Reset to defaults is not described.
Item numbers are step order chosen here; the ESC does not sound item numbers.
Input voltage, cell count and current ratings are not stated in the text read.
